messages:
Alex: Heads-up — nightly perf dashboard flagged a p95 spike on canary-A around 02:12 UTC. Throughput down ~18%, p95 ~2x baseline. Anyone on this?
Mira: I saw it. Correlating with last night's merge: PR #8241 (batching-scheduler-tweak).
Sam: CI showed a small perf flicker for that PR earlier (ci/perf/8241) but it was marked as flaky by the author. Noted p95 +20% there.
Alex: Can we get a quick profile from a canary replica? Need kernel selection + KV cache traces.
Mira: Running perf prober now on canary-A:
```
perf-prober run --pool canary-A --trace kernel-selector,kv-cache --duration 120s
```
Mira: Deploy bot shows the canary came from that PR. Starting trace, will paste highlights when done.
deploy-bot: Deployment started: rolling canary for release v1.44-pr-8241 at 01:58 UTC.
Mira: Quick findings: kernel-selector started choosing fallback kernels much more often (~48% of requests) vs ~5% baseline. Batch window avg rose from ~4ms -> ~9ms in the same traffic slice. KV cache evictions spiked 1.2k -> 6.8k in 10m. CPU stalls increased on memcpy hotspots.
Sam: I pulled a flamegraph — agrees. The changed heuristic raised the "prefer_high_memory" weight; effectively it prefers kernels that inflate memory usage and push out KV entries.
Cassie: I can run a focused bisect on the commits inside 8241. Plan: revert the kernel-selector tweak first (it's small) and rerun nightly before doing larger reverts.
Alex: Also consider applying the kv-hysteresis patch as a quick mitigation if revert takes time. That should reduce eviction churn.
Mira: Kicking off bisect job:
```
/home/build/bin/nightly-bisect --pr 8241 --range 8240..8242 --metric p95 --retries 3 --traces kernel-selector,kv-cache
```
ops-bot: Alert suppressed for canary-A until bisect completes (oncall override).
Sam: If bisect reproduces, we should revert 8241 from canary and promote a hotfix; can't keep canary unstable.
Cassie: Bisect finished — culprit is the selector change in 8241 (commit abcdef). It increases fallback decisions by ~32% for our canary traffic. Opening revert PR (#8250) now.
deploy-bot: Revert PR #8250 merged; rolling back canary v1.44-pr-8241 -> v1.43-hotfix at 03:12 UTC.
Mira: Post-revert metrics: p95 back to baseline, throughput returned, KV evictions down to ~1.5k. Leaving canary on hold for 1h to confirm stability.
Alex: Good catch. Action items: 1) add unit/regression test for selector epsilon behavior; 2) schedule kv-hysteresis experiment; 3) author of 8241 to run microbench and propose a safer heuristic. I'll file the tasks and tag owners. :white_check_mark:
